title: Add 5 JS-emitted event handlers to WebSocketBridge ParseEvent
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — MSA-ADAPT-003/004

Five events emitted by `MineflayerAdapter/index.js` have no C# ParseEvent handler in `WebSocketBridge.cs`:
- `disconnected` — no C# event type exists
- `reconnected` — no C# event type exists
- `blockBelowChanged` — event type exists but no parse entry
- `blockMineSkipped` — no C# event type exists
- `creativeProvisionComplete` — no C# event type exists

All five fall through to `_ => null` and are silently discarded.

**Recommendation:** Create typed C# event records for the missing event types (DisconnectedEvent, ReconnectedEvent, BlockMineSkippedEvent, CreativeProvisionCompleteEvent). Add parse entries. Update WorldStateProjector if needed.
